create_asset_card: create an AssetCard with a name, metadata dict, and optional parent card for inheritance
test_field_access: test accessing a field value from an AssetCard using the field method and value property
test_field_type_check: test that accessing a field with the wrong type raises an AssetCardError via as_ method
test_field_as_uri: test converting an AssetCard field value to a URI using the as_uri method
test_missing_field_error: test that accessing a non-existent field on an AssetCard raises an AssetCardError
